descricao_original: This toluidine-blue stained section shows the dermal-epidermal junction. The papillary layer of the dermis contains finer caliber collagen fibers and is more cellular than the reticular layer, which is marked by thicker collagen bundles and fewer cells. Toluidine blue stain, 200x
